title: Great product
text: Great product. This not only looks great but the suction works too and keeps my kids from getting their toothbrush and rinse cups from being cross contaminated.

product_metadata.title: LEVERLOC Toothbrush Holder Wall Mounted Suction Cup Toothbrush Holder NO-Drilling Removable For Bathroom Toothbrush and Toothpaste Holder Family Set with 3 Cups Multi-function Mirror Toothbrush Holder
features: 【Large Capacity & Well Organized】- Not only a toothbrush holder, but also a storage tray. LEVERLOC wall mounted toothbrush holder suction cup helps well organized your toothbrush, toothpaste, combs, razors, etc. Save space and keep your bathroom clean and tidy. Three cups design of the hanging toothbrush holder is suitable for a family.

【Damage-free Installation & Strong Adhesion】- Patent suction cup design of the toothbrush and toothpaste holder provides sturdy and durable adhesion. Waterproof in shower and Maximum load 11LBS. Just push the suction cup of toothbrush holder for shower and finish installation in one second. No drilling, no screws, no holes, no glue, no tools, no hurt to your wall surface.

【Dust & Waterproof, Clean & Health】- Upside-down cups of the hanging toothbrush holder for bathroom help dust prevention and fast water draining so to keep dry and clean effectively. Caring heighten base design of the mirror toothbrush holder keeps cups from falling. It's also easy to dismantle for cleaning.

【Reusable & Repositionable】- The wall mounted toothbrush holder is easy to remove and re-install to a new location for reusing. Just use a credit card to remove the suction cup of toothbrush and toothpaste holder and wash it with warm water before re-installation. It is ideal for normal household, condominiums and rentals use.

【Premium Material & 100% Satisfaction】- LEVERLOC toothpaste and toothbrush holder suction cup is made of TPE sucker, PC elastic sheet, and ABS material，which is waterproof, oil-proof, durable and no smell. Please feel free to contact us if you have any problem with the white toothbrush holder.
